messages:
Diego Moreno: FYI dedicated canary is blocked — p95 jumped after merge #3246. Routing is picking the new quantized int8 kernel for longseq traffic and falling back to the slow path. Looks customer-impacting :warning:

Alice Chen: saw the same in metrics dashboard. customer-pool-42 p95 up ~2.3x starting at the merge timestamp. Not just canary — some dedicated nodes also hit the spike.

Ben Patel: deploy-bot fired a CI perf alert earlier: 
```
[CI PERF] skyline-check: p95 regression detected in runtime-integration (baseline 12ms -> current 31ms)
link: https://ci/reports/skyline/3246
```

Clara Gomez: did a quick local profile on a reproducer. Kernel selection log shows the selector preferring "quant-int8-v2" for sequences >1024 due to changed weight-pref heuristic in the merge. When that kernel mis-aligns with KV cache chunking, we go to the slow fallback loop. Snippet: 
```
kernel_choice: quant-int8-v2 (score 0.72)
kv_lookup: hit_rate 0.94
latency_ms:  p50 8  p95 28  p99 62
slow_path_entered: true
```

Diego Moreno: that 28ms p95 matches what we see on canary traces. This explains both the CI failure and the dedicated SLA risk.

Ben Patel: bisect narrowed it to commit `3f9b7a2` (the quant selector tweak) — verified by reverting locally and seeing latency go back to baseline.

Clara Gomez: additional note — batching heuristics interact here too. The new kernel has worse throughput for microbatch slicing alignment; when many longseq requests coalesce we get head-of-line amplification.

oncall-sre: tagging for customer impact. We have open alerts for 2 paid dedicated clusters. SLA breach risk if left.

Diego Moreno: we should block the rollout. Plan: 1) hold canary and stop rollout 2) open revert PR for the selector change 3) hotfix to pin quantized kernel threshold to previous behavior 4) run targeted perf CI and a short dedicated-staging run. Agree? :thumbsup:

Alice Chen: agree. I'll file a rollback ticket and notify sales/success for affected accounts.

Ben Patel: I'll draft the revert PR (small diff) and include perf traces. Will run the quick bisect test matrix. ETA 30m.

Clara Gomez: I'll prepare profiling artifacts and a short doc describing kernel-selector heuristics and interaction with KV chunking so we don't reintroduce this.

deploy-bot: [action required] rollout paused for release/3246 due to perf regression.

Diego Moreno: thanks — once revert PR is up I'll trigger a canary at previous commit and monitor p95. If stable, we can resume rollout after a day of green metrics.

Alice Chen: filing customer comms now.

Ben Patel: PR opened: https://git/repo/pulls/4321 (revert selector tweak). Running perf CI now.

Clara Gomez: added perf graphs to PR and linked the reproducer.

Diego Moreno: good work — keeping this thread as the single source for the rollback work. We'll capture root cause in a postmortem after.

oncall-sre: noted — will extend alert retention for the impacted clusters while we verify.
